name: QingFlow
description: QingFlow no-code platform connector. Build apps, manage records, automate approval workflows, and export data via natural language.
authorization.title: Authorize a QingFlow account
authorization.description: Enter your personal QingFlow token in the POCO authorization form. Accessible workspaces, apps, and data are determined by that QingFlow account's permissions.
authorization.token.label: QingFlow Token
authorization.token.description: How to obtain: Log in to QingFlow → Click the avatar in the bottom-left corner → Personal Center → Account Information → Security Information → Authorization Code
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP endpoint
configuration.endpoint.description: The official QingFlow remote MCP endpoint. Keep the default value.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.apps.title: App building
capabilities.apps.description: Find apps and groups; create or adjust forms, layouts, views, workflows, charts, and portals.
capabilities.records.title: Data management
capabilities.records.description: Query, create, update, and delete form records, and import or export data as supported by the remote service.
capabilities.tasks.title: Tasks and approvals
capabilities.tasks.description: Read tasks, task details, and workflow logs, and perform approval actions.
capabilities.analysis.title: Queries and analysis
capabilities.analysis.description: Read views, charts, and associated reports; query workspaces, members, departments, and roles.
limits.title: Usage limits
limits.description: Available tools must be returned by the remote service and allowed by this connector. Session workspace switching, uploads using local paths, and local import-file repair are unsupported; verify the target workspace before acting. Writes, deletions, approvals, and code-block execution require confirmation. After a timeout, check the result before submitting again.

examples.listApps.description: List all apps in my workspace
examples.pendingRecords.title: Find pending approvals
examples.pendingRecords.description: Query all pending approval records in the leave form
